Problem (rule): the table gives each of the 29 rule marks a verdict and a recommendation. The lane's counts, unchecked by triage: 21 keep, 7 change, 1 drop. - CHANGE style-plain-words: cut to one sentence; keep the pointer to the root rule.
- CHANGE style-question-form: shrink to a pointer to its decision plus one line of intent; the guard stays (it is 210 words, 18% of the file).
- CHANGE style-question-inside-box: fold its one unique clause (text before the box may not show) into style-question-form; drop the rest.
- CHANGE style-hand-off-cleanup: merge into style-hand-off-irreversible.

- CHANGE style-press-has-link: move to the waiting-page skill; the guard stays.
- CHANGE style-command-in-item: move to the waiting-page skill; the guard stays.
Based on (read): the table in PR #3340, read by triage in full; its evidence is the lane's, unchecked. No rule's fire rate is measured (the cloud has no guard.log).

Meanwhile: nothing changes; the lane's PR #3340 is held and the rules stay as they are.
